_comment: Accepted Semgrep findings (contrib/semgrep/README.md, 'Accepting a finding'). findings: fingerprint -> {rule, path, reason, by, date}. rule_paths: [{rule (glob), paths (globs), reason, by, date}]. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can check.

rule_paths.reason: Upstream zcashd workflows kept byte-for-byte except a trigger/if scoping: they run only for upstream's master or only in zcash/* (release-docker-hub.yml), so their findings are upstream's. The same files and reason as .github/zizmor.yml.
